statement: Every material governance capability in this repository, with its canonical source, its authority class, whether anything actually consumes it, which validator recomputes it, and what a future Gate must do about it. The purpose is to make "work already produced but forgotten, unratified or unlinked" impossible: a future Gate reads this matrix instead of rediscovering the same ground.
liveConsumerRule: A capability is CANONICAL_LIVE only where a real consumer was identified and, where it is executable, actually executed at this baseline HEAD. A document existing on disk is never sufficient.

statusVocabulary.CANONICAL_LIVE: Canonical, and something really consumes it.
statusVocabulary.CANONICAL_NOT_CONSUMED: Canonical and correct, but no production consumer calls it yet.
statusVocabulary.DERIVED_ONLY: A generated projection; never an authority.
statusVocabulary.SUPERSEDED: Historically valid, replaced by a later canonical source.
statusVocabulary.STALE: Points at something that no longer holds.
statusVocabulary.DUPLICATE: A second copy of an authority that already has a canonical home.
statusVocabulary.GENUINE_GAP: Nothing in the repository provides this capability.

sourceOfTruthGraph.statement: Exactly one authoritative source or resolver per governance domain. Scanned for PARALLEL_AUTHORITY, SHADOW_AUTHORITY, GENERATED_FILE_USED_AS_AUTHORITY, STALE_POINTER_AUTHORITY and UNRESOLVED_PRECEDENCE; none were found.

domains.precedence: Owner ratification documents are the upstream source; the registry is the single canonical projection consumers read. Not parallel: the registry pins each source by sourcePath and, where declared, sourceSha256.
Append-only ledger replay only. governance/state/generated/GATE_STATUS_SNAPSHOT.json is DERIVED_ONLY and is never read for status.
Bound to immutable activation-event identity; deliberately does not pin the mutable projection it names.
The pointer, never a fixed R0001 filename. Succession is recorded by a single-use local authority.
NATIVE_EVENT_PIN from ordinal 59 onward; LEGACY_STATE_BINDINGS for ordinals 57-58 only, and those grant no permission.
Evidence is confirmed by an independent session, never by its producer.
Discovery is by programId and must match exactly one document; AUTHORITY_NOT_UNIQUE_OR_ABSENT blocks otherwise, which is what makes a parallel authority impossible here.
Declared dependency, resolved against ledger status.
GENERATED_FILES_NON_CANONICAL. Every generated file declares canonical=false and drift is detected by recomputation.
Exact relative paths only; wildcards are rejected at validation time.

standardGateGoldenPath.statement: The generic three-mission Gate lifecycle, each transition mapped to the primitive that performs it and the GATE14 precedent that already exercised it. Nothing here requires a new generic mechanism.

transitions.requiredAuthority: PRECONTRACT_AUTHORITY or the authorization authority path manifest

mission2.name: IMPLEMENTATION -> TESTS -> EVIDENCE -> CLOSURE MATRIX -> AGENT_CLOSURE -> COMPLETE_AGENT

mission3.name: INDEPENDENT REINSPECTION -> EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION -> COMPLETE_CONFIRMED -> FINAL COMMIT

transitions.primitive: EXTERNAL_REINSPECTION_REPORT in a separate main-agent session
transitions.evidence: reinspection report with re-derived digests and ledger replay
transitions.consumer: the EXTERNAL_CONFIRMATION authority binds its path and digest

transitions.evidence: consumption record naming the transaction id and commit message

standardGateGoldenPath.newGenericMechanismRequired: NONE. Every transition above has an implemented primitive, a validator, and a GATE14 precedent.

minimumEvidenceFrontier.statement: What each lifecycle phase must actually re-run. The full governance suite stays available as regression evidence but is not mandatory where a smaller sufficient frontier is proven, and it must never be run mechanically to produce a number.

loadBearing: the R5 route plan, which names exactly the tasks whose evidence R3/R4 could not prove unchanged
ledger replay across the gate ordinals
phases.notRequired: rerunning the full suite for a count

minimumEvidenceFrontier.unjustifiedGlobalSuiteExecutions: NONE FOUND. No workflow in governance/ mechanically executes the whole suite as a gating step.
